word-search.name: Find the character
word-search.intro: Pick strokes of a big character to form the smaller characters hidden inside it.
rules: Each round shows a big character (from the words you picked). Smaller characters hide inside it, e.g. 减 contains 口, 冫, 戈, 咸.
Tap strokes to select them (they turn red), then press Check. If they form a hidden character it fills a slot, with pinyin and Sino-Vietnamese reading.
Find 3 / 5 / 7: find that many hidden characters to move on. Any valid one counts, even if it is not in the hints.
Hint: first shows the pinyin and meaning of a hidden character, then highlights its strokes. Give up shows all of them.
word-search.find_in: Find {{n}} hidden characters in the character of
word-search.msg_bad: These strokes do not form a character. Try again.
word-search.hint_text: Hint: a hidden character reads {{p}}, meaning "{{m}}". Press Hint again to see its strokes.
word-search.all_parts: Hidden characters in {{c}} ({{n}}). Hover or tap to see the strokes:
word-search.no_chars: No character in these words has {{n}} hidden characters. Pick more words or a lower level.

shooter.name: Word archery
shooter.intro: Lanterns carrying Vietnamese meanings float into the sky. Recall the word and type its pinyin to shoot them.
rules: Each lantern shows a Vietnamese meaning, the first letter of the pinyin and blanks for the rest (e.g. "s _ _" is suì).
Type the full pinyin (no tones needed, e.g. "wanfan" or "wan3fan4"). A match fires at once and shows the characters.
A lantern that escapes off the top costs a life. You have 4 lives.
Every 8 words is a milestone and lanterns get faster. There is a 1.5× button and pause.
shooter.tip: No tones or spaces needed. A match fires at once; Enter clears the box.

match.name: Match cards
match.intro: Tap a character and its meaning (two lily pads) to clear the pond before time runs out.
rules: The pond has 6, 8 or 10 pairs of pads: one with the character (and pinyin), one with its meaning (or pinyin).
Tap a pad, then its partner. A right pair blooms into a lotus, a wrong one counts as a mistake.
Each pond has a countdown (pairs × seconds per pair). If time runs out, you lose.
Face-down mode: pads are hidden and you flip two at a time.

bugs.name: Bug catcher
bugs.intro: A bug carrying a Vietnamese meaning crawls to the garden. Pick the right character before it eats a cabbage.
rules: Each round a bug with a Vietnamese meaning crawls down toward the cabbages.
Pick the right character among 4 buttons (or press 1–4). Catch it early for more points.
A wrong pick costs a cabbage (a life), and so does a bug reaching the garden. You have 3.
Bugs get faster every round. There is a 1.5× button and pause (key P).
bugs.tip: Keys 1–4 to pick, P to pause.

solitaire.name: Word solitaire
solitaire.intro: Solitaire in Chinese: open a foundation with a topic card, then collect all the word cards of that topic.
rules: There are topic cards (crown, showing how many words to collect: 3, 4, 5, 6 or 8, at random) and word cards, all in Chinese. The 拼音 button shows or hides pinyin; ↻ on a card flips it for pinyin and meaning, and VI / EN picks the meaning language.
Put a topic card on an empty foundation to open it, then add all its word cards. A full foundation clears.
In the columns a word card goes only on a card of the same topic. Empty columns take any card. Tapping any card of a same-topic stack picks up the whole stack.
Tap the deck to draw; tap again when empty to recycle. Tap a card to pick it up, tap a place to drop it, double-tap to send it to a foundation.
Moves are limited. Clear every topic before they run out. Every deal is checked to be solvable; use Hint or Undo (undo gives the move back).
solitaire.not_enough: Not enough words for at least 2 groups. Pick more HSK levels or sets, or change the grouping.
solitaire.stuck: No way to win from here. Undo a few moves or start a new game.
solitaire.cat_info: opens a foundation, needs {{n}} word cards.
solitaire.tip: Tap a card to pick it up (its meaning shows here), then tap where to drop it. ↻ flips a card.
solitaire.out_of_moves: Out of moves, try a new game!
solitaire.stages_intro: Each HSK level has 50 stages built from the 300-topic HSK 1–6 list; topics per stage grow from 4 to 6. Cards are in Chinese; press ↻ on a card to flip it for pinyin and meaning.
solitaire.flip: Flip to see pinyin and meaning
solitaire.pinyin_toggle: Show or hide pinyin on cards
solitaire.not_enough_moves: The shortest win found needs {{n}} more moves but only {{left}} are left. Undo a few moves or restart.
